regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow and concentrated in Financials/Energy: Banks lead, Energy (H-shares) is a challenger, High-Dividend Blue Chips and Conglomerates & Exchange round out the eligible set. Momentum ranks are display-only (rank-IC ~0), but the absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so eligibility is a staying-power filter, not a return signal. Only two themes are scorable, both tech and both ineligible.
emerging_watch: Watching whether China Tech & Internet (3033.HK, scorable) — currently rank 14, ineligible, mean-revert hurst — reclaims the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true) and shows breadth above 0.5; that observable combination would retire this watch as a potential handoff from the Financials/Energy leadership cluster.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy (H-shares) is the strongest eligible trend outside Banks: it clears the absolute-trend gate (eligible=true), has the highest durability_bar (0.80) and breadth (0.90) in the eligible set, with a clean 'trend' hurst_tag and no crowding. In a regime where the only validated edge is drawdown/shake-out avoidance via the trend gate, this is the least fragile eligible theme. The call is a relative-persistence lean, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Energy (H-shares) has no scorable ETF proxy and is a commodity-exposed H-share sleeve; H-share energy is highly sensitive to global oil/coal price reversals and onshore policy, which the detector does not see. Its score (1.153) is also a function of recent relative momentum, which has no forward edge.

falsifier.text: H-share energy breadth drops below 0.5 and durability_bar falls under 0.55 before the check-by date, with the theme losing eligible status.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks (H + HK) is the dominant narrative leader (rank 1, score 1.337) and clears the trend gate (eligible=true). Its durability_bar (0.63) is moderate but breadth (0.615) and mixed hurst tag suggest a cohesive but not runaway trend. Crowding is absent (crowded=false, z=0.81 below threshold). Per the guardrails, this is NOT a buy because it leads — it is a persistence lean consistent with a trend-following, vol-aware allocation, and the leader is not to be faded.
theses.dissent: Banks have a mixed hurst tag (not a clean trend), lower durability than Energy, and unspectacular breadth (0.615). As the most consensus-visible leader, it is also the most exposed to any rate-policy or credit-cycle surprise, and momentum leadership has no forward return edge.

falsifier.text: The Banks theme falls below Energy (H-shares) in rank and its durability_bar drops under 0.50 before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips is eligible (trend gate passed), has a clean 'trend' hurst tag, solid breadth (0.75), and a mid-range durability_bar (0.65). It is the third leg of a narrow Financials/Income leadership cluster. In a validated-trend-gate-only regime, eligibility plus trend-health is the humble basis for a persistence lean, not an alpha claim.
theses.dissent: High-dividend themes in HK are rate-sensitive and defensive; if global yields reprice or the AI-tech macro narrative (the single dominant macro theme in the backdrop) triggers a risk-on rotation, defensive income could lag the broad index even while remaining technically eligible.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips' breadth falls below 0.50 or the theme drops out of the eligible set before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
